column1: # The shipped IC2 config files address vanilla items the way 1.12.2 did: pre-flattening ids plus a
# metadata value. This table maps those references onto the modern ids so the config files can stay
# Format: <1.12 name>[@<metadata>]<TAB><1.21 id>. A name without a metadata suffix is the fallback
# for that name, which is also what an "@*" (any metadata) reference resolves to.
# Only differing names are listed; anything absent keeps its id.
